text: dsh-chatgpt-codex 是 DSH 模型接入插件：它向 DSH 注册 openai-codex provider，把 ChatGPT Codex Responses 接入主模型调用。支持浏览器回调和设备码登录、OAuth 凭据刷新、模型目录选择，以及将文本、推理摘要和工具调用流转换为 DSH 消息。适合希望在 DSH 中使用 ChatGPT 账号运行 Codex 模型的用户；需要 ChatGPT 账号和本机 Node.js 环境。

dsh-chatgpt-codex connects Codex models to DSH through an openai-codex provider. It supports browser and device-code sign-in, token refresh, model selection, and streaming text, reasoning, and tool calls into DSH.

Use your **ChatGPT account and Codex models inside DeepSeek Harness**. This standalone DSH plugin supports both a localhost browser callback and headless device-code authentication, refreshes OAuth tokens automatically, and streams Codex Responses into the native DSH message/tool protocol.

No OpenAI API key. No `pi-ai` runtime dependency.

dsh-chatgpt-codex README · dsh-chatgpt-codex：> [!IMPORTANT]
> DeepSeek Harness does not currently ship ChatGPT/Codex OAuth for its main model route. It has a Codex subagent launcher that reuses the official Codex app's login, but that is a separate one-shot delegation path. This plugin fills the main-model gap and targets the current DSH `next` API (`0.1.0-rc.6` or newer).

dsh-chatgpt-codex README · Features：- ChatGPT browser OAuth with PKCE, a strict state check, and a localhost callback
- ChatGPT device-code OAuth for SSH, containers, and headless machines
- Automatic access-token refresh with in-process and cross-process rotation locks
- Owner-only atomic credential storage under `$DSH_HOME`
- Native `openai-codex` DSH model provider—no `pi-ai` adapter
- Official OpenAI JavaScript SDK for the Codex Responses transport
- Streaming text, reasoning summaries, function calls, images, usage, and finish reasons
- Encrypted reasoning-item replay for correct multi-turn Codex sessions
- Current GPT-5.6 Luna, Terra, and Sol discovery entries, plus GPT-5.5/5.4 models
dsh-chatgpt-codex README · Install in two minutes：The repository commits its built artifacts, so GitHub installation does **not** run a dependency `prepare` script.

dsh-chatgpt-codex README · 1. Sign in with ChatGPT：Browser callback (recommended on a desktop):

```sh
pnpm dlx github:sudipnext/dsh-chatgpt-codex#v0.1.0 login
```

Device code (recommended over SSH or in a container):

```sh
pnpm dlx github:sudipnext/dsh-chatgpt-codex#v0.1.0 login --device
```

The default credential file is `$DSH_HOME/chatgpt-codex/auth.json`, or `~/.dsh/chatgpt-codex/auth.json` when `DSH_HOME` is unset.

dsh-chatgpt-codex README · 2. Add the DSH bundle：```sh
dsh plugin --profile codex add github:sudipnext/dsh-chatgpt-codex#v0.1.0
```

dsh-chatgpt-codex README · 3. Run DeepSeek Harness：```sh
dsh --profile codex
```

The bundle registers `openai-codex` and selects `gpt-5.6-luna` as the profile's default model. A later profile patch can choose another model.

dsh-chatgpt-codex README · Configuration：| Setting | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `authFile` | `$DSH_HOME/chatgpt-codex/auth.json` | OAuth credential document |
| `issuer` | `https://auth.openai.com` | OAuth issuer, primarily for compatible deployments/tests |
| `baseURL` | `https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex` | Codex Responses base URL |
| `originator` | `dsh-chatgpt-codex` | Honest product identity sent upstream |
| `models` | Current bundled catalog | Advisory DSH model picker entries |

| `textVerbosity` | `low` | `low`, `medium`, or `high` |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `300000` | Provider request timeout |
dsh-chatgpt-codex README · Configuration：The model catalog is advisory. Actual model availability depends on the signed-in ChatGPT plan, workspace policy, region, and current OpenAI rollout.

dsh-chatgpt-codex README · Why this does not use pi-ai：DeepSeek Harness's general `llm-pi-ai` adapter intentionally does not expose OAuth-only providers because it has no credential store or login lifecycle. This project owns the missing lifecycle directly:
section: Why this does not use pi-ai

text:
dsh-chatgpt-codex README · Why this does not use pi-ai：1. The CLI performs ChatGPT PKCE or device-code authentication.
2. `AuthManager` stores and rotates the OAuth token set.
3. `CodexAdapter` converts native DSH history/tools to stateless Responses input.
4. The official `openai` SDK carries the HTTPS/SSE transport.
5. The stream translator emits DSH blocks and stores the encrypted replay items needed on the next turn.

See [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) for the exact components and trust boundaries.
section: Why this does not use pi-ai

text:
dsh-chatgpt-codex README · Security：- OAuth state is cryptographically random and compared in constant time.
- PKCE uses S256 and a fresh verifier for every login.
- The callback server listens only on `127.0.0.1` and closes after one result.
- Credentials are written atomically with mode `0600` on POSIX; parent storage uses `0700`.
- Tokens are never printed by status, errors, tests, or logs.
- This plugin uses its own credential file rather than copying `~/.codex/auth.json`, avoiding refresh-token rotation races with the official Codex client.
dsh-chatgpt-codex README · Security：Read [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) before reporting a vulnerability. `logout` removes local credentials but does not revoke the OpenAI session remotely.

dsh-chatgpt-codex README · Compatibility and status：This is an independent community plugin, not an official OpenAI or DeepSeek project. Both Codex's private ChatGPT backend and pre-release DSH APIs can change. The repository pins behavior with keyless OAuth, wire, replay, and storage tests; releases describe any required migration.

Using ChatGPT/Codex remains subject to your OpenAI account terms and workspace policy. A ChatGPT subscription does not guarantee every catalog model.

dsh-chatgpt-codex README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run check
```

The test suite uses local HTTP servers and synthetic JWTs; it does not require or read real ChatGPT credentials.
